summary.headline: Florentine Codex Astrological Contents
summary.text: Catalog entry for a Florentine codex of astrological apotelesmatics, formerly owned by Angelo Poliziano and found among Giovanni Pico della Mirandola’s books. Its folios include planetary motions, zodiacal signs, horoscopes, trigons, exaltations, hour-markers, solar eclipses, an index of ecliptic chapters, and Ioannes Camaterus’s astrological poem.
